sections.text: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Wood makes it grow, a standard rising with you. As a catalyst, the order around you runs thin and you supply it from inside. Your own promises and rules become the structure you lean on.

sections.head: THE CHARACTER
sections.text: Bars: Leadership · Responsibility · Flexible · Structured

sections.head: KEYWORD · Keeps your word
sections.text: You keep your word long after it stops being convenient. Being counted on is the respect you want, so you put a promise ahead of your comfort. Anyone who has your yes builds on it without a second thought.

sections.head: KEYWORD · Earns every step
sections.text: Earning every step takes longer than asking for it. Since a rank you never requested sits easier on you, you wait for the title rather than claim it. Promotions you deserved have gone to louder people.

sections.head: KEYWORD · Holds the line
sections.text: You hold the line for everyone, even for those who need an exception. Since one exception feels unfair to the rest, you give the rule in place of a second chance. A friend in real trouble gets the same answer from you as anyone.

sections.head: THE ADVICE
sections.text: You feel most like yourself when your effort has a name and an end. Sign up for one class that ends in a test. Pick one goal for this season and mark the finish on a calendar.

sections.head: THE EDGE
sections.text: Wood runs through your family, your social life and your career. It is the word you give at home that everyone leans on, the handshake friends trust more than the paperwork, and the long way up at work while others look for shortcuts.

sections.head: THE REMEDY
sections.text: Seek Metal, your own Body energy. Metal is what stays when the wanting stops, the rest under the effort. Let it trim what Wood spreads. You treat rest as time stolen from building. sections.head: THE CHARACTER
sections.text: Bars: Intuition · Stability · Instinct · Research

sections.head: KEYWORD · Sees it whole
sections.text: You see the whole answer first and work out the steps after. You need the shape of a thing before its parts, so you trust what you saw rather than what you can prove. Your leaps often land where others arrive months later.

sections.head: KEYWORD · Self-taught
sections.text: Self-taught is the only learning you trust. Because a thing has to be found before it feels true, you spend months finding it alone rather than an hour being told. Much of your time goes into ground others crossed years ago.

sections.head: KEYWORD · Good listener
sections.text: Being a good listener is your first move. Since speaking up feels like a risk, you keep listening rather than give the help asked of you. Friends who came for your advice leave with only your sympathy.

sections.head: KEYWORD · Looks after people
sections.text: You look after people without being asked. Keeping the people near you sheltered is how you feel at ease, so you look after their comfort before yours. Under your roof, everyone breathes out.

sections.head: THE ADVICE
sections.text: Your Mind grows on warmth, and warmth is something you have to go and sit near. Once a month go to a talk or a workshop just to take it in. Keep one person to ask the simple question, and ask it.

sections.head: THE EDGE
sections.text: Fire runs through your mind, your growth and your career. It is the feeling you trust before the reasons show up, the person you are quietly turning into before anyone notices, and the finished thing you see while the page is still empty.

sections.text: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Earth holds it, and nothing you learn is lost. As a friction, the holding never stops. Familiar ground draws you in, every change looks like a threat, and your world grows smaller each year.

sections.head: THE CHARACTER
sections.text: Bars: Intuition · Stability · Instinct · Research

sections.head: KEYWORD · Stays near home
sections.text: You stay close to home and the few people who hold you steady. Being held is where you feel most yourself, and you go back to that shelter over any open road. The wider world reaches you mostly second-hand.

sections.head: KEYWORD · Overprotective
sections.text: When trouble lands on someone you love, you protect them as your own. You carry their trouble rather than let them carry it, and pick up weight nobody handed you. You look after everyone and leave no one looking after you.

sections.head: KEYWORD · Same old answers
sections.text: Your first answer to someone's new idea is the same old one. Because you find a tested answer kinder, you give the old one rather than the one asked for. You send them off with your answer in place of theirs.

sections.head: THE REMEDY
sections.text: Seek Wood, the Action energy. Wood draws on the ground it grows from and turns what it takes into something built. Let it spend what Earth stores. You stay with what you already know rather than put it to use. Send the rough draft before the clean one exists. Try a new method on a familiar problem.
